result.rationale: The trajectory shows the team successfully reaching the reactor and picking up the research-core (turn 2), but the intended aggressive probe to recover the core is blocked by sustained hostile and environmental pressure rather than by information or route formation. Medic Reyes is repeatedly hit by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 damage in turns 2, 3, 4, 5), dropping from 90 to 15 to 0 (dead by turn 5). Meanwhile the reactor-instability hazard deals 10 damage per turn to Engineer Imani and Security Chen every turn they remain in the reactor zone (turns 2-5), and reactor-heat climbs 62→100, crossing thresholds. The team is pinned in the reactor area by the hazard and by pirates (Hacker Nyx, Raider Holt, Captain Veyra) converging on Command Deck/Reactor Console, while the engineer holding the research-core cannot extract. The core was acquired but never recovered because survival/spatial pressure (hazard damage + hostile fire + zone capacity contestation) blocks the extraction affordance. This is the dominant causal bottleneck: the useful affordance (recovering the core) exists but is not actionable due to health/position/hostile pressure.
